styleGuide.subtitle: Development only. 48 dp touch targets, icon with text and outdoor contrast.
styleGuide.title: Style guide — Campo claro

commandPalette.label: Search and commands
commandPalette.inputLabel: Search machines, work orders, reports, rentals, customers and farms
commandPalette.minLength: Type at least {count} characters to search records.
commandPalette.error: Search failed. Check your connection and try again.
commandPalette.hint: Use the arrow keys to move, Enter to open and Esc to close.

ops.body: Today at a glance: what is in the field, what is late and who is working now.
ops.tasks: Follow open work orders, see technicians on the map and open any item to act on it.

attention.body: Everything that needs an office decision, sorted by urgency.
attention.tasks: Resolve critical reports, late work orders, rentals about to end and sync failures.

reports.body: Reports sent from the field app: checklists, photos, defects and signatures.
reports.tasks: Filter by asset or status, review a report and turn it into a work order.

workOrders.body: Work orders from request to close: who does it, where, when and what it cost.
workOrders.tasks: Create and assign work orders, follow their status and close them with parts, hours and a signature.

rentals.body: Assets rented to customers, with period, prices and return status.
rentals.tasks: Open a rental, record pick-up and return, and see what is about to end.

assets.body: Machines and implements, with hour meter, history and documents.
assets.tasks: Add an asset, check its service history and print its QR label.

sites.body: Farms, fields and yards where assets work or are kept.
sites.tasks: Add sites, see them on the map and check which assets are at each one.

customers.body: Customers who hire services or rentals, with their contacts and sites.
customers.tasks: Add customers, see their work orders and rentals and keep contacts up to date.

team.body: People in your organisation and their office or field role.
team.tasks: Invite people, change roles and see each technician's workload.

devices.body: Phones and tablets that use the field app with your organisation's account.
devices.tasks: See when each device last synced and revoke access for a lost device.

templates.body: Checklist templates that technicians fill in on the field app.
templates.tasks: Create and publish checklists with required items, photos and signatures.

seasons.body: Seasons group services and costs by farming period.
seasons.tasks: Open and close seasons to compare costs and output between periods.

costs.body: Costs recorded on work orders, assets and seasons: parts, labour and fuel.
costs.tasks: Record costs, filter by period and export them for accounting.

imports.body: Spreadsheet imports to add many records at once.
imports.tasks: Upload a CSV of assets, customers or team members, check the preview and confirm.

settings.body: Organisation details, time zone, language and work rules.
settings.tasks: Adjust company details and the preferences that apply to the whole team.

subscription.body: Your AgroRende plan, usage limits and invoices.
subscription.tasks: Check plan usage, change plan and download invoices.

notifications.body: Recent alerts about work orders, reports and rentals that involve you.
notifications.tasks: Mark alerts as read and open the related item in one click.

account.body: Your personal details, password and sign-in preferences.
account.tasks: Change your name, password, language and theme.

analytics.body: Operational indicators: asset availability, lead times and costs.
analytics.tasks: Compare periods and find the assets and services that weigh the most.

parts.body: Catalogue of parts used in maintenance, with code and price.
parts.tasks: Add parts and see which work orders and assets used them.

stock.body: Parts on hand per site, with receipts, issues and reorder minimums.
stock.tasks: Record stock movements and see what is below the minimum.

maintenance.body: Preventive maintenance plans by hour meter or calendar.
maintenance.tasks: Create plans, see what is due soon and generate the work orders.

fuel.body: Fuel fills per asset, with litres, hour meter and average consumption.
fuel.tasks: Record fuel fills and spot assets with unusual consumption.

billing.body: Charges to customers for services and rentals.
billing.tasks: Create charges, follow payments and export the documents.
